parts:
Hey Juergen,
Sorry it took a bit to get back to you, I have been in field classes the past couple of weeks.
I will attach a sample of the excel data to the email.
In summary, we are looking at the depredation of snowy plover nest. Some nest are successful and they hatch, so these would want to have their site ID and then maybe like a "SpeicesID" as just Hatch or something along that line. For the nest that were not successful due to depredation, we need to tag those sites and images as the species that caused the depredation or that the nest was just abandoned. 
The entire excel file format was created in 2011 and has data dating back to then so it was not organized with the intention of using camtrapR, so maybe I need to change the layout or something.
Let me know what you think or if you want anymore information.
Again I really appreciate how helpful you are!
Cheers
Madeline
P.S I will also post this in the group
